caption: Close-up portrait of an elderly Middle Eastern woman looking calmly into the lens, her face filling the tall frame. A cream headscarf and the collar of a dark green cardigan frame her chin. Soft overcast daylight smooths the fine lines of her skin, and the olive grove behind melts into silvery blur.

Cheeks puffed, a white man in his sixties leans over a birthday cake on a kitchen table and blows out a ring of thin candles, the flames bending away from him. A checked flannel shirt covers his grey t-shirt, his grey hair neatly combed. The cake has plain white frosting and fresh strawberries, and medium-format film keeps the colours warm and natural in the centred square composition.

Golden-hour light slants through a bamboo grove onto a giant panda sitting on mossy ground, a wide cinematic view with the bear placed left of centre. It grips a green stalk in both front paws and chews, its black-and-white fur glowing at the edges where the low sun catches it. Tall bamboo stems stretch away to the right, their leaves lit amber, and soft haze fills the gaps between them.
